data.title: 爱夏·花宴之前
data.action: 左手托住布置板，右手用铅笔标记长桌的位置
data.description: 爱夏站在庭院石径的一侧，左臂托住布置板，右手用铅笔在图上标出花宴长桌的位置。酒红与象牙白的长袖礼服垂至脚踝。横幅中人物位于左侧，右侧石径通向尚未摆满的长桌和花圃；晨光同时照亮图板边缘与桌面，呈现布置尚在进行的一刻。
data.promptProse: On the left of the frame, she balances the board on her left forearm and marks a table position with her right hand. Morning light reaches the board; to the right, the path leads to partly arranged banquet tables and flowerbeds.
data.animaCaption: The board rests on her left forearm as her right hand marks the plan.
